stem_book: Fill in the blanks: (i) The number of values of θ for which sin2θ + cos2θ = 2 is ____ (ii) The number of solutions which satisfy the equation 3cos x + 4sin x = 6 is ____ (iii) sin²θ = 1/2; if the general solution of it is θ = nπ ± α then α is ____ (iv) tan²θ = 3; then the general solution of the given trigonometric equation is θ = nπ ± α, then α is ____

work: (i) max(sin2θ+cos2θ) = √2 < 2 ⇒ 0; (ii) 6 > √(9+16) = 5 ⇒ 0; (iii) sin²θ = sin²(π/4) ⇒ α = π/4; (iv) tan²θ = tan²(π/3) ⇒ α = π/3
